2125793977282523152.en_summary: $SPY false breakdown remains a hypothesis with evidence until it closes above $730.02 and holds. Reclaim and hold turns Nov 19-25 into a textbook bear trap; rejection at $730 confirms the breakdown with that level as resistance.
2125793977282523152.zh_summary: $SPY 的假跌破仍是有證據支持的假設，直到收盤站穩 $730.02 以上。若收復並守住，11 月 19 至 25 日將成為教科書式熊市陷阱；若在 $730 再次被拒，則確認跌破，該價位成為阻力。

ticker_notes.SPY: 需收盤站穩 $730.02 確認假跌破或跌破

2125790039686729898.en_summary: Avis $CAR call buying building into breakout: 3,527 calls vs 1,610 avg, short-dated $140-$180 strikes adding ~75K-115K share exposure. Daily chart 11-day bull flag after +29% run, measured move ~$160. Historical bull flags hit target 11/22 times. $160 target, $150 trigger, $130 floor, Dec 4 catalyst. Notes prior close $141.82 +9.6% on 609K shares, high short interest ~35% of float.
2125790039686729898.zh_summary: Avis $CAR 買權買盤於突破中累積：昨日成交 3,527 張對比平均 1,610 張，短期 $140-$180 行使價增加約 75K-115K 股暴露。日線圖為 +29% 漲幅後的 11 日牛旗，量度目標約 $160。歷史牛旗 22 次中 11 次達標。目標 $160，觸發 $150，地板 $130，12 月 4 日催化劑。指出前收盤 $141.82 漲 9.6% 僅 609K 股，短倉約佔可交易流通股 35%。

2125789748367384799.en_summary: SpaceX $SPCX says it will give one newly issued share to every currently active Trump Account, and Elon Musk says he will personally match it, resulting in two SpaceX shares per account.
2125789748367384799.zh_summary: SpaceX $SPCX 表示將向每個目前活躍的 Trump Account 發放一股新發行股份，Elon Musk 表示將個人匹配，即每個帳戶獲得兩股 SpaceX 股份。

2125788260685492339.zh_summary: $QQQ 2018 年從歷史高點到谷底跌 23%，之後 Powell 轉向，股市 V 型反彈。今日從歷史高點到谷底已跌 21%。質疑是否會出現 V 型反彈。
